what_is.a: PrediGol analyses football matches with data and statistical models: it shows a forecast of every match, compares the market's odds and publishes picks only when it finds value with enough evidence. It is information for people 18 and over: it takes no bets, pays no prizes and recommends no operator.

no_pick.q: Why is there no pick today?
no_pick.a: A pick is published only when a match meets every rule: value against the odds, enough evidence and a validated model. If no match meets them, there is no pick that day. We never fill the space with picks: Home tells you why there was none.

forecast_pick.q: What is the difference between a forecast and a pick?
forecast_pick.a: The forecast is the probability PrediGol computes for every match, bet or no bet. Value appears when that probability is higher than the one the odds imply. A pick is a case with value that also passed every publishing rule. The glossary explains the three layers.

guarantee.q: Does PrediGol guarantee I will win?
guarantee.a: No. No probability guarantees a result: a 70% chance fails three times out of ten. In “How PrediGol is doing”, once it is published, you will see the real results with their sample, the bad ones too.

cant_sign_in.q: I cannot sign in to my account
cant_sign_in.a: Check that your e-mail is spelled right and that caps lock is off. After several failed attempts the account waits a few minutes before letting you try again. If the sign-in screen shows “Forgot your password?”, use it: a one-use link reaches you. If it does not, or the link expired, write to us on WhatsApp or by e-mail (Contact, below) and we help you the same day.

two_steps.q: How do I turn on two-step verification?
two_steps.a: In your profile, under “Security”: you scan a code with an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator and keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. From then on, signing in also asks for the app's code.

language_zone.q: How do I change the language or the time zone?
language_zone.a: The language changes with the ES / EN switch at the top. The time zone, in your profile: every time in PrediGol is shown in the zone you choose.

renew.q: How do I renew my membership?
renew.a: PrediGol does not charge cards inside the app. Write to us on WhatsApp or answer the reminder e-mail; once we record your payment, your membership is extended and you see it in your profile, under “Membership”, with its dates.

membership_ends.q: What happens when my membership ends?
membership_ends.a: We remind you a few days before. When it ends you have 3 days of grace with everything. After that the account has limited access: you still see your profile, your saved picks, this help, the legal texts and your data, and you get everything back as soon as you renew.

trial.a: A new account starts with a trial (usually 20 days) with full access. Your profile shows how many days are left; before it ends we tell you how to continue.

what_pick.a: A concrete selection — a market, an option and the odds it was judged at — that PrediGol publishes because it passed all its rules. Every pick says why it was published and is settled when the match ends; its result counts in the record, win or lose.

own_selection.a: A selection you save on your own, even if PrediGol did not publish it as a pick. It always carries the label “Your selection” so it is never confused with a PrediGol pick, and it does not count in PrediGol's results.

parlay.a: A parlay joins several selections into one bet: the odds multiply, but a single miss loses it, so the risk grows with every selection. While you build it, PrediGol shows the combined odds, its risk and whether two selections depend on each other.

when_settled.a: When the match ends and the data provider confirms the result, usually minutes after the final whistle. If the provider corrects a result, PrediGol settles that match's picks again and you will see the change in My picks.

void_half.q: What do refunded, void and half won mean?
void_half.a: Refunded: the stake comes back, for example when the result lands exactly on the line. Void: the match was not played or was suspended and the selection does not count. Half won (or half lost): on quarter-goal lines, half is won (or lost) and the other half is refunded. The glossary explains each one.

units.a: Every pick is measured as if 1 unit were staked: winning at odds of 2.10 adds 1.10 units and losing takes 1 away. The return is what was won divided by what was staked. With few picks those figures swing a lot, which is why they always come with their sample.

emails.q: Which e-mails does PrediGol send, and how do I turn them off?
emails.a: The ones about your account, its security, your privacy requests and important changes to the legal texts always arrive. Membership and support ones can be turned off in your profile, under “Notifications”. We never send advertising without your permission.

install.q: How do I install PrediGol on my phone?
install.a: On iPhone, open PrediGol in Safari, tap Share and then “Add to Home Screen”. On Android, open it in Chrome, tap the menu and then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”. It opens like an app, without a store.

my_data.q: What data does PrediGol keep about me?
my_data.a: Your account's, your consents, what you save (picks, parlays, favourites), your messages to support and your membership. In your profile, under “Privacy and data”, you can download all of it in one file (we ask for your password) and ask for it to be corrected.

delete_account.q: How do I delete my account?
delete_account.a: In your profile, under “Privacy and data”, ask for the deletion: we ask for your password and handle it within the legal deadline (15 business days). Your account is anonymised: what is yours is deleted and only what the law requires is kept.

report_context.q: What is sent when I report a problem?
report_context.a: Your message and just enough to understand what happened: the screen you were on, the reference of the last error, PrediGol's version, the kind of device and whether you use the installed app. Never your password, sign-in links or what you typed in other forms.

should_bet.q: Should I bet on the picks?
should_bet.a: PrediGol informs; the decision is yours. If you decide to bet, set beforehand how much you can lose and do not go past it, do not chase losses and use only operators licensed in Colombia by Coljuegos.

get_help.q: I feel gambling is harming me
get_help.a: Talk to someone you trust or to a health professional. In “Responsible gambling” you will find the warning signs and Colombia's free help lines.

push.q: Can I get notices on my phone?
push.a: Yes: the result of what you save, your teams' line-ups, one summary a day, your account and the reminders you set with a match's bell. Turn them on in your profile, under «Notifications», or when PrediGol offers it. They never arrive from 22:00 to 08:00 (except your reminders), at most 3 a day, and you turn them off in one tap.

push_iphone.q: Why don't notices reach my iPhone?
push_iphone.a: On an iPhone or iPad, notices only reach PrediGol installed on the home screen (iOS 16.4 or later). In Safari, tap Share and then «Add to Home Screen», open it from its icon and turn them on in your profile. If you blocked them, allow them in Settings → Notifications → PrediGol.

updates.title: What's new
updates.intro: What changes in PrediGol, newest first. When a change comes from what readers tell us, we say so.

forYou.title: Home, yours first
forYou.body: If you follow leagues, teams, players or markets, Home starts with «For you»: your matches today and their news, your players, the picks of your matches with the reason («Your league», «A market you follow: …») and the results of the last 48 hours. PrediGol follows below, the same for everyone. If there are no picks of yours today, it says so: it never fills the space.

summary.title: The match Summary, first to understand
summary.body: Before kick-off, a match's Summary opens with the reading and the forecast, then the published picks and the best prices. Form, table, head to head, schedule, absences and line-ups are still there, one tap further down, under «Go deeper».

compactWhy.title: Each pick's why, in one line
compactWhy.body: The compact cards of Home and Picks say in one line the probability PrediGol gives against the market's, and the picks of the day show up to two risks the context review noted, when that review can be seen.

competitions.title: More competitions
competitions.body: PrediGol now also follows the World Cup qualifiers of Africa and Oceania and the Asian Cup.

followMore.title: Follow players and markets too
followMore.body: In Profile → Your football, besides leagues and teams, you can follow up to 20 players and 5 markets; also with «Follow» on a player's card or in a match's Markets tab. They only order what you see: they change no pick, probability or price.

keyPoints.title: Key points and «Why there is value»
keyPoints.body: At the top of each match's Summary, up to five key points with what PrediGol expects and what weighs most. When PrediGol publishes a pick of that match, «Why there is value» compares its probability and its price with the market's. A pick with value can lose: it is not a promise of a result.

howItWorks.title: How PrediGol works
howItWorks.body: In Help, a page explains each part of the app in a card, with an example.

explain.title: Explain, the answer to your question
explain.body: On every match, every pick and your parlay there is an «Explain» button: choose a frequent question («Why is there no pick?», «What can go wrong?») and get the answer from what PrediGol already knows. No AI and nothing made up: if a piece of data is missing, it says so.

feedback.title: Your opinion, once a month
feedback.body: Now and then we will ask you how useful PrediGol was to you (once a month at most, and it can always be skipped), and at the end of every analysis and every pick explanation you can say whether it was useful. Whatever we change thanks to those comments, we will tell you here.

myPicks.title: My picks, complete
myPicks.body: Everything you saved, by day and with filters; the balance of your results with a notice while they are still too few to draw conclusions; your price against the closing price, and a CSV download of your data.

postmatch.title: After the match
postmatch.body: When a match ends, its After the match tab shows what PrediGol expected against what happened, how each published pick ended and why, and how what you saved ended.

whyPick.title: Why this pick?
whyPick.body: Every published pick explains its reasons in layers, the conclusion first, and says its state in words.

football.title: Your football first
football.body: Follow your leagues and your teams: Home, Matches and Picks start with them. You can change them whenever you like from your profile.

matchCentre.title: Match centre and PrediGol Analysis
matchCentre.body: Every match has its summary, the PrediGol Analysis with the data behind it, statistics, markets, line-ups and verified news with their source. Tap a term to see what it means.

help.title: Help, profile and the app on your phone
help.body: A help centre with common questions and «Report a problem» from any error; a profile that brings together your account, privacy, security and notices; and PrediGol can be installed on your phone like an app.

suggest.title: What would you like to change?
suggest.body: Tell us: we read every suggestion, and whatever changes thanks to them will show up here.

howItWorks.title: How PrediGol works
howItWorks.subtitle: Every part of the app on one card: what it is, how to read it and an example.
howItWorks.intro: PrediGol is a sports analysis and value-detection platform. It is not a bookmaker, it takes no betting money and no forecast guarantees a result. It is for people aged 18 or over only.
howItWorks.exampleNote: The numbers in the examples are made up to explain: they are not real picks or odds.
howItWorks.footer: Still not clear? Look the word up in the glossary or write to us from Help.

home.title: Home
home.what: Your summary of today: the matches of your leagues and teams (or the suggested leagues until you choose yours), today's picks or the reason there are none, PrediGol's parlays, the best odds and the results of the last 48 hours.
home.read: Each block says where it comes from. When one is empty, it says so and does not pad it: no pick today is an answer, not a failure.
home.example: “Your leagues do not play today” does not mean the app is broken: that block is empty because there are no matches, and the others are still there.

matches.title: Matches
matches.what: The matches of the competitions PrediGol follows, by day. The ones being played also appear in “Live”.
matches.read: Tap a match to open its match centre: everything PrediGol knows about it is there, from the forecast to the post-match.
matches.example: Open a match from today and you will see its forecast, its context and its markets in one place, without jumping from screen to screen.

picks.title: Picks
picks.what: A selection with value against the market price, at the best odds available now. Only the ones PrediGol recommends are shown; if none passes every rule, there are no picks that day and it is not padded with others.
picks.read: Each pick brings its match, its market and its odds, and “Why this pick?” sums up the conclusion, the context, the market and the risks. The filters sort by competition, market, odds and start time. Tap the odds to add them to your parlay.
picks.example: PrediGol gives the home side a 55 % chance, so that option is “worth” odds of 1.82 (1 ÷ 0.55). At odds of 2.00 it pays more than it is worth and there is value; at 1.70 there is none, even if the home side is the favourite. To be a pick it also has to pass the rest of the rules.

parlays.title: Parlays
parlays.what: A combination of selections that wins only if all of them win. PrediGol builds the daily and the multi-day parlay only from selections that pass all its rules, with no related selections and no padding. You can also build your own, with the automatic builder or by tapping odds.
parlays.read: The odds multiply, and so does how hard it is to win. One lost selection loses it all; a refunded or void one counts as odds of 1 and the parlay goes on with the rest.
parlays.example: Three selections at 1.80, 2.00 and 1.50 give odds of 5.40 (1.80 × 2.00 × 1.50). If all three win, it wins; if one fails, it loses.

odds.title: Odds
odds.what: The best odds of each selection among the bookmakers PrediGol follows, compared with its fair odds: what it would pay if bookmakers charged no margin.
odds.read: If the best odds are above the fair ones, they pay more than the market as a whole. Odds change, so each one carries the time it was read, and one far above the rest is usually a stale or wrong price from a single bookmaker.
odds.example: If the market's probability, without margin, is 50 %, the fair odds are 2.00. Best odds of 2.10 pay 5 % more than the fair ones.

myPicks.title: My picks
myPicks.what: What you save: your picks, your selections and your parlays. They settle by themselves with the official result, and your figures come from there.
myPicks.read: Each one starts pending and, when the match ends, becomes won, lost, refunded, half won, half lost or void. Your figures count only the ones that have odds.
myPicks.example: A saved pick at 2.10 that wins settles as “Won” and adds 1.10 units; if the match ends exactly on the line, it is “Refunded” and the unit comes back whole.

favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.what: The leagues and teams you follow. You choose them when you join or in Profile, under “Your football”, and also with the star in a match's header.
favorites.read: Home shows their matches first and says why each one is there. Until you choose, you see the leagues suggested for Colombia.
favorites.example: If you follow a team, its matches come first on Home. Following a team never changes a pick, a probability or odds.

analysis.title: Match analysis
analysis.what: The centre of each match: the forecast, the context (form, table, head to head and absences), the market, the line-ups, the news and, when it ends, the post-match.
analysis.read: The forecast says what is likely. If there is also value against the market and the selection passes every rule, it appears as a pick. A match with no pick does not mean a match with no analysis.
analysis.example: A home favourite at 60 % may have no pick if its odds already pay less than it is worth: the analysis is there and the pick is not.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.what: How many times out of a hundred something would happen. PrediGol gives its probability for each result of a match (the forecast) and compares it with the one deduced from the odds.
probabilities.read: There are three different numbers: PrediGol's probability, the implied one of an odds price (1 ÷ odds, with the bookmaker's margin inside) and the market's (the bookmakers' without their margin). None guarantees a result: a 70 % fails three times out of ten.
probabilities.example: If the market, without margin, says 50 % and PrediGol says 55 %, the edge is +5 percentage points: PrediGol sees the option 5 points more likely than the bookmakers do.

markets.title: Markets
markets.what: A kind of bet on a match and its options. PrediGol analyses five: full-time result (1X2), over/under goals, both teams to score, Asian handicap and double chance.
markets.read: Each market settles by its own rules, and PrediGol settles only the markets it knows: an option of another market cannot be saved. In a match, the Markets tab lists them.
markets.example: “Over 2.5 goals” wins with three goals or more; “Under 2.5”, with two or fewer. With a whole line, like 2, a match that ends with 2 goals returns the unit.

states.title: Pick states
states.what: A pick has two kinds of state. The visible one: a reader only sees “Recommended” picks, the ones that pass every rule; picks PrediGol does not recommend are not shown and the app says how many were left out. And the result one: pending, in play and, when the match ends, won, lost, refunded, half won, half lost or void.
states.read: “Under evaluation” is an internal label: a selection whose model does not yet beat the market is measured, but never recommended or shown. A pick being “Recommended” does not guarantee it wins.
states.example: A “Recommended” pick at 2.10 that wins is “Won” and adds 1.10 units; one that lands exactly on the line is “Refunded”; one whose match is cancelled is “Void” and adds or subtracts nothing.
